title: Web Application Firewall on Application Gateway and on Front Door

videos.script: A network firewall sees addresses and ports. An attack on a web application arrives on port 443 like everybody else. {{ports}} A web application firewall reads the request itself: the path, the headers, the body. It matches them against rules written for known attacks. {{reads}} Azure offers one in two places, at the edge and in the region. This lesson writes the shop's policy, starts it in detection, and adds the rule only the shop could write: a limit on checkout. {{end}}
